text:
Elena Chen: Morning — quick async standup for the sprint bridge. What I did: finished spec edits for routing fallback and updated rollout page. Blockers: waiting on infra confirmation for dedicated routing flag. Today: polish release notes, hand off rollout checklist to @Kate.

Samir Patel: Did code review for the embed cache PR (links/PR #842). Left one comment about the KV cache expiry. No blockers from my side, can address after lunch. @Mike can you grab the final review? :pray:

Jorge Rivera: Investigated the staging perf spike. I can repro locally when sequence length > 4k under batch=16. Need a heap profile from staging to confirm. Can someone run this quick command and paste logs?

Jorge Rivera: ```
curl -X POST https://staging-redwood/api/v1/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-ggml","input":"<long prompt>"}' \
```

Kate Morgan: Thanks — priority for launch: 1) routing fallback spec signoff, 2) embed cache PR merged, 3) canary playbook updated. Please flag any rollback criteria you want in the playbook. We should freeze noncritical API changes after 3pm PT today.

Mike O'Neill: I'll take Samir's PR review at 2pm PT. Quick FYI — I'll need ~30m to reproduce Jorge's perf case; if infra can attach heap profile before then it's faster.

deploy-bot: CI run for branch/feature/embed-cache failed on integration tests (redis-timeout). Build https://ci.redwood/1234 :warning:

Samir Patel: noted — I'll rerun CI after fixing the expiry comment. @deploy-bot can you queue a re-run after my push?

Elena Chen: Good call on freeze. Kate — I've uploaded the rollout checklist to the drive and added a section for rollback signals. Link in the launch doc. 

Kate Morgan: Great. Small ask: if we see a high error-rate (>2%) during canary, auto-fallback to smaller model variant and alert on-call. I'll add to playbook. :eyes:

Mike O'Neill: On it. I can add the fallback config and a simple tracer tag to detect model swap events.

Jorge Rivera: For the heap profile, here's the exact staging command I need (will be quick):
```
sudo perf record -F 99 -a -- sleep 30 && sudo perf script > /tmp/perf.out
```
If infra can't run, ping me and I'll SSH in.

Elena Chen: Wrap-up: Samir will push PR fixes by 1:30pm PT, Mike takes review at 2pm, Jorge will capture staging heap by 3pm, Kate to finalize playbook by 4pm. Ping here if anything slips. Thanks! :thumbsup:
